description: Read-only token refresh status for one saved broker credential owned by the authenticated user. Use this after Schwab or Tradier OAuth snapshot runs to verify whether Node persisted rotated token material. In a reconnection conclusion, state the returned snapshotStatus and snapshotVerifiedAt separately from authorizationSavedAt and subsequentRefreshVerifiedAt, with their actual dates. A verified snapshot and a later verified token refresh each establish their own successful check; neither proves that a strategy ran. When an unchanged active schedule is evidenced, describe its next run as scheduled to attempt, with no guarantee. Authorization saved, fresh snapshot verified and a later required refresh verified are separate facts. A historical scheduled skip is not replayed by reconnecting; successful connectivity cannot guarantee the next market-day run. Returns distinct authorizationSavedAt, fresh snapshot verification status/time/error, subsequent required refresh verification time, broker metadata, refresh eligibility, tokenRotationVersion, and sanitized tokenRotationAudit fields such as lastRotatedAt, lastPurpose, and lastRotatedKeyNames. Raw broker credentials, Vault ids, runtime secret ARNs, rotation grant metadata, and secret values are never returned.
name: get_broker_token_refresh_status
title: Get broker token refresh status
